notes.title: Kickstarter Announcement Trailer Release!
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone!

We’ve got HUGE news today: our Saintess of the Golden Bow Kickstarter campaign launches on [b]March 19th[/b]! That’s right, it’s just around the corner! 🚀

To celebrate, we’re thrilled to share our [b]brand-new trailer[/b] for Saintess of the Golden Bow! 🌟

[previewyoutube=lw15nQnwS4g;full][/previewyoutube]

But that’s not all – our demo just got a small patch to make your experience even smoother:
 ✨ Fixed typos 
 ✨ Squashed a bug in the log
 ✨ Subtle updates to Elijah’s and Father’s expressions
 ✨ Minor GUI refinements

Remember that the demo is fully compatible with Windows, MacOS, and Linux!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45375438/e7151979a01ca86e096af98036d752333374dc99.png[/img]

[b]Looking ahead:[/b]
 The next demo update will drop [b]on Kickstarter launch day (March 19th)[/b] and will include:
 💡 An additional 30 minutes of gameplay
 🎨 Brand-new CGs
 🎙️ Fresh voice acting
 🔄 The main twist of the game – we hope as you're excited about finding out what it is as we are about finally making this part of the narrative public!

This will mark the [b]final demo length at 4 hours of gameplay[/b]. We’re so excited for you to experience what’s next in Celeste’s journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45375438/820a23665f46f48be0e7dafbc6314bbcae0923dc.png[/img]

If you haven’t yet:
 [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/transparentgms/saintess-of-the-golden-bow-otome-visual-novel?utm_source=mailingkstrailer]👉 Follow us on Kickstarter[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3419240/?utm_source=mailingkstrailer] 👉 Wishlist us on Steam[/url]

Your incredible support has brought us this far, and we’re so grateful to have you on this journey. Let’s make March 19th unforgettable! 💛

With love,
The Transparent Games Team

notes.title: March Development Update 🚀
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We’re back with exciting news about Saintess of the Golden Bow! Starting today, we’re proud to participate in the [b]Visual Novel Fest[/b] on Steam. To celebrate, we’ve made some amazing updates to our demo!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45375438/9a7baea65496ac1fc5d2e677d3a2a4edf823d326.png[/img]

[h3]What’s New in the Extended Demo?[/h3]
[b]📖 3.5 Hours of Gameplay:[/b] Dive deeper into Celeste’s journey and the crew’s mission against the Demon Queen, with 30 minutes of new branching content to explore!
[b]🎙️ New Voiced Scene:[/b] Enjoy a heartfelt moment between George and Celeste.
[b]💻 Now on MacOS & Linux:[/b] Our extended Steam demo is now available for Mac and Linux players! This build is significantly longer than the itch.io version, giving you more to experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45375438/a45a17be8257566836b4ccdae7e84f54f394f18e.png[/img]

[h3]Milestone Achievements! 🎯[/h3]
🎮 [b]1362+[/b] Wishlists on Steam!
We’re so grateful for the incredible support! Haven’t added us yet? Wishlist us here:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3419240/?utm_source=mailingvnfest]👉 Steam Page[/url]

💌 [b]300+[/b] Followers on Kickstarter!
We’ve surpassed 317 pre-launch followers! Be the first to know when our Kickstarter goes live by following us here:
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/transparentgms/saintess-of-the-golden-bow-otome-visual-novel?utm_source=mailingvnfest]👉 Kickstarter Page[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45375438/c11d00f8555653cd3678ec5e8bdd17e80c1e6903.png[/img]

[h3]Meet Meredith: The Hard-working Nun![/h3]
If you’ve played the extended demo, you’ve already met [b]Meredith[/b], one of Elijah’s closest allies. As the overseer of the cathedral’s construction in Solus, she’s serious yet kind, fully devoted to her role—but she has secrets that will only be revealed in Elijah’s route in the full game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45375438/64e1df59c69ef0500edeab67bb9b7b768187ab5b.png[/img]

Thank you for continuing to support Saintess of the Golden Bow! Your enthusiasm means the world to us, and we’ve got even more exciting updates coming your way soon.

[h3]✨ Don’t forget to:[/h3]
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/transparentgms/saintess-of-the-golden-bow-otome-visual-novel?utm_source=mailingvnfest]💌 Follow us on Kickstarter[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3419240/?utm_source=mailingvnfest]🎮 Wishlist us on Steam[/url]

With [b]love[/b],
The Transparent Games Team

notes.title: Development Update #8
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45375438/4034abced1ffe4559a83f0da5dd6850b31848023.png[/img][h1]✨Saintess Development Update #8: 100+ Kickstarter Followers & Big Announcements![/h1]

Hello, everyone!

We’re back with some amazing updates for Saintess of the Golden Bow! Let’s dive into what’s new:

[b]🎉 100+ Kickstarter Pre-Launch Followers![/b]

We’ve hit an incredible milestone—137 followers (and counting!) on our Kickstarter Pre-Launch Page! 💛 Thank you all for the support! If you haven’t subscribed yet, now’s the time:

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/transparentgms/saintess-of-the-golden-bow-otome-visual-novel?][b]👉 Follow us on Kickstarter[/b][/url]

[b]🎮 Steam Next Fest Demo Launch Date Announced![/b]

We’re thrilled to confirm that Saintess of the Golden Bow will be part of Steam Next Fest with an expanded 2.5-hour demo!

Here’s what’s new in the demo:
🌟 2 stunning new CGs by our Lead Artist, Lidia
🎙️ Fully voiced scenes for the opening until Levi’s first CG (we're still sticking to only having CGs avoiced!)
🎭 Meet new characters with their own beautifully designed sprites
💫 Even more heart-racing moments with Celeste and the main cast

[b]🎤 Voice Actor Reveal: Ariana Rosario as Celine[/b]

We’re so excited to introduce the incredible Ariana Rosario, the voice behind Celine! Check out her reveal card below:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45375438/592336927b57b56f70493fed6b1b938731a3784b.png[/img]

[b]🖌️ New GUI in Progress![/b]

We’re collaborating with the talented kathaeris (creator of the GUI for A Date with Death) to give Saintess a fresh, polished look. The new GUI won’t be in this demo, but we’re thrilled to share a sneak peek of our updated textbox design:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45375438/03fab2880af6956b079f7052bf5af6d2372f4e34.png[/img]

Stay tuned for even more updates as we finalize colors and bring this vision to life!

[b]📍 Meet Us at Animangapop Plymouth![/b]

We’re coming to Animangapop Plymouth on Saturday, February 8th!
Swing by our booth to grab an exclusive Saintess of the Golden Bow sticker featuring your favorite love interest—or Celeste herself! 💘

Thank you for your continued support and excitement for Saintess of the Golden Bow. We’re so proud of how far this project has come and can’t wait to share even more with you soon!

[b]With love,
The Transparent Games Team[/b]

[b]🌟 Development Update: Meet Garreth[/b]

No devlog would be complete without a peek at what's to come for Saintess of the Golden Bow! Today, we’re introducing Garreth, a new character in the upcoming Extended Demo:

[b]Who is Garreth?[/b]
Elijah’s right-hand man, Garreth is a devout priest in the Church of the God of Light, managing the paperwork and logistics that keep everything running smoothly. But what will he think of Celeste? 🤔
We’re excited to share his sprite—check it out below:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45375438/fa5ed00adbb7e246d1c0f539b237162d0693db59.png[/img]

Thank you for your continued support and excitement for Saintess of the Golden Bow. Whether it’s subscribing on Kickstarter, wishlisting on Steam, or following us on TikTok, every little bit helps us bring this story to life.

[b]With love,
The Transparent Games Team[/b]
